08 / A few good questions

Clarity starts
with a question.

How we work, who we work with, and what happens next. We keep things clear from the start.

Explore all FAQs ↗
Do you work with startups or large companies?

Both. We work with ambitious startups and established businesses looking to scale or rebrand. What matters most is your drive to grow.

What makes Avocadots different?

We connect creativity and data. Branding, web design, and marketing work together, with one team focused on your business goals.

Do you work internationally?

Yes. Our clients are based in Cyprus and across Europe. We collaborate remotely and adapt to your audience, market, and language.

How much does a website or branding project cost?

Pricing depends on your goals, timeline, and scope. We outline costs and deliverables before work begins, so you know what to expect.

Can you manage everything for us?

Yes. From brand identity and websites to content, advertising, and CRM, we can bring the work together under one team and strategy.

How long does a typical project take?

Most website and branding projects take 4–12 weeks, depending on scope and complexity. We agree on a clear timeline and milestones before starting.
